_note: Shared worked-example inputs for FMS engineering item 7 (electrical & safety principles): guide docs/FMS system design/67_electrical_safety.md, tools/fmse/*.py, web/fmse7*.js. All values are EXAMPLES for teaching - real projects use the current editions of IEC 60364, IEC 60204-1, IEC 60890 / IEC 61439, ISO 12100, ISO 13849-1/-2, ISO 13855, ISO 14119, ISO 13850, IEC 62061 and the manufacturers' data. Tables marked 'example table' must be checked against the standard edition used in the project. Everything is deterministic: guide, tools and web must give IDENTICAL numbers.

_formulas.load_list: per load: P_d = qty*P_kW*ku ; Q_d = P_d*tan(acos(cosphi)) ; totals P = sum P_d, Q = sum Q_d ; S = ks*sqrt(P^2 + Q^2) [kVA] ; cosphi_total = P/sqrt(P^2+Q^2) ; I = S*1000/(sqrt(3)*U) ; S_req = S*growth ; transformer = smallest standard size >= S_req ; transformer loading = S/S_T
_formulas.short_circuit: the cell is fed from the PLANT transformer S_plant (load_list.plant_transformer_kVA): Ik3 at its secondary (infinite upstream network, cable impedance neglected) = S_plant*1000/(sqrt(3)*U*uk) [A] ; the transformer size from load_list is the size a DEDICATED cell transformer would need ; breakers must have breaking capacity Icu >= Ik3 ; panel SCCR >= Ik3
_formulas.motor_current: I_n = P*1000/(sqrt(3)*U*eta*cosphi) ; DOL starting current = k_start*I_n ; star-delta starting current = k_start*I_n/3 ; VFD input current ~ P*1000/(sqrt(3)*U*eta_total*0.95) not used
_formulas.cable_size: required Iz = In/(k_temp*k_group) ; choose the smallest cross-section A whose table ampacity Iz_table >= required Iz (table = ampacity table below) ; conditions Ib <= In <= Iz_table*k_temp*k_group ; PE size: A <= 16 -> A_pe = A ; 16 < A <= 35 -> 16 ; A > 35 -> A/2 (IEC 60364-5-54 simple rule; use next standard size >= A/2 from the table sizes)
_formulas.voltage_drop_3ph: dU = sqrt(3)*Ib*L*rho*cosphi/A [V] (reactance neglected) ; dU% = dU/U*100 ; limit 5 % (example project limit, IEC 60204-1 orientation)
_formulas.fault_loop: TN system: R_loop = L*rho*(1/A + 1/A_pe) ; Zs = Z_ext + R_loop ; Ik1 = U0/Zs ; disconnection OK if Ik1 >= Ia with Ia = magnetic (instantaneous) trip current = m*In (m: B 5, C 10, D 20 or the breaker setting) ; L_max = (U0/Ia - Z_ext)/(rho*(1/A + 1/A_pe))
_formulas.dc24_budget: I_load = sum I*qty*sim ; PSU rating = smallest standard size >= I_load*reserve ; channel (electronic circuit breaker) current = sum of its loads ; channel rating = smallest ECB rating >= channel current*reserve
_formulas.dc24_drop: two-wire line: dU = 2*L*I*rho/A ; U_load = U_psu - dU ; OK if U_load >= U_min (21.6 V = 24 V - 10 %) ; L_max = (U_psu - U_min)*A/(2*I*rho)
_formulas.cabinet_area: IEC 60890 effective surface (W, H, D in m): free-standing all sides: A = 1.8*H*(W + D) + 1.4*W*D ; against a wall: A = 1.4*W*(H + D) + 1.8*D*H ; wall-hung (back to wall) same as 'against a wall'
_formulas.cabinet_heat: P_loss = sum of losses [W] ; natural dissipation P_nat = k*A*(Ti - Ta) (negative if Ta > Ti) ; needed cooling Q = P_loss - P_nat ; if Q <= 0: no active cooling ; else if Ta < Ti - 5: filter fan V = 3.1*Q/(Ti - Ta) [m3/h] (factor 3.1 at sea level) ; else: cooling unit with useful power >= Q [W] ; k = 5.5 W/(m2 K) painted sheet steel
_formulas.risk_graph: ISO 13849-1 Annex A: PLr from S (S1 slight, S2 serious), F (F1 seldom/short, F2 frequent/long), P (P1 possible to avoid, P2 scarcely possible): S1F1P1 a, S1F1P2 b, S1F2P1 b, S1F2P2 c, S2F1P1 c, S2F1P2 d, S2F2P1 d, S2F2P2 e
_formulas.mttfd: n_op = d_op*h_op*3600/t_cycle_s [operations per year] ; MTTFd(component) = B10d/(0.1*n_op) [years] ; T10d = B10d/n_op [years, replace the component before] ; channel MTTFd = 1/sum(1/MTTFd_i) ; two different channels: MTTFd = 2/3*(C1 + C2 - 1/(1/C1 + 1/C2)) ; then cap at 100 years ; band: low 3 <= x < 10, medium 10 <= x < 30, high 30 <= x <= 100 (below 3: not allowed)
_formulas.dcavg: DCavg = sum(DC_i/MTTFd_i)/sum(1/MTTFd_i) (uncapped MTTFd values) ; band: none < 60 %, low 60 <= x < 90, medium 90 <= x < 99, high >= 99
_formulas.pl_from_cat: PL of a subsystem from (category, DCavg band, MTTFd band) with pl_table below (simplified bar chart, ISO 13849-1 Figure 5). Column choice: Cat B and 1 use 'none' (any DC); Cat 2 and 3: DC band low -> 'low', medium or high -> 'medium', none -> not allowed ; Cat 4: only DC high allowed. 'n/a' = combination not allowed. Cat 2, 3, 4 also need CCF score >= 65.
_formulas.ccf: CCF score = sum of points of the applied measures (ISO 13849-1 Annex F) ; required >= 65 for categories 2, 3, 4
_formulas.pl_combine: safety function = series of subsystems (input, logic, output) ; PL_low = lowest PL ; N_low = number of subsystems with PL_low ; result: a: N<=3 a else none ; b: N<=2 b else a ; c: N<=2 c else b ; d: N<=3 d else c ; e: N<=3 e else d (ISO 13849-1 Table 11 simplified method) ; verdict OK if PL >= PLr
_formulas.safety_distance: ISO 13855: T = sum of times [s] ; AOPD (light curtain), perpendicular approach, resolution d <= 40 mm: S = 2000*T + 8*(d - 14) ; if S < 100 -> S = 100 ; if S > 500 -> S = 1600*T + 8*(d - 14), and if this is < 500 -> S = 500 ; multi-beam / d > 40 (body): S = 1600*T + 850 ; laser scanner, parallel approach: C = max(850, 1200 - 0.4*H) with H = height of the protective field [mm] ; S = 1600*T + C + Z (Z = scanner + measuring tolerances) ; two-hand control: S = 1600*T + 250 (C = 0 if the hands are covered) ; S in mm
_formulas.guard_locking: access time t_access = distance_mm/1600 [s] (walking / reaching speed 1600 mm/s) ; guard locking required if t_stop > t_access (the hazard is still moving when the person arrives) ; ISO 14119
_formulas.safety_zones: cause & effect: each row = condition (all_of inputs true AND none_of inputs false) -> actions per output ; action ranks RUN 0 < SLS 1 < SS1 2 < STO 3 ('-' = no action) ; output result = highest-ranked action of all rows whose condition is true, RUN if none ; 'latched' rows need a reset after the input clears ; KPI: number of outputs still RUN (production continuity)
